svg.title: The close of the dsh panel: patrol, seven days of tasks, and the pages they open
svg.desc: Annotated excerpts from three live-host captures taken on 2026-10-18, not a desktop screenshot or one synchronized state. Original proportions are preserved. The queue capture is in English; the stats and patrol pages were captured with the Chinese locale.
svg.text: Real interface excerpts • three captures from one day • original proportions
Two summaries close the queue; each opens a page of its own.
One patrol row, one stats card, the ops footer.
Seven days, stacked by provider; then each agent.
Four numbers first, then every round.
Open issues by area; rounds by lens.
The stats and patrol pages use the
Chinese locale. The card and the chart
were read at different times that
day, so their totals differ. Full
originals are linked below the figure.
Tokens and cost are frozen when a task ends; cost is an API list-price estimate.
Patrol rounds are left out of the week. The footer turns red when the installed ops entry differs.
